public_sources.bound_semantics: Auer, Cesa-Bianchi and Fischer's UCB1 for bounded rewards in [0,1] initializes by playing each machine once, then selects machine j maximizing current average reward plus sqrt(2 ln n / n_j). The paper analyzes this exploration/exploitation policy under independent bounded stochastic reward streams.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Treat each currently eligible assignment as an arm and each exact same-scope terminal utility normalized to [0,1] as one observed reward. Persist accepted reward count and sum per assignment plus semantic completion keys.
chat_native_reduction.selection_rule: After at least one accepted reward per eligible assignment, select argmax mean_i + sqrt(2*ln(N)/n_i); exact ties use lexicographic assignment id.
chat_native_reduction.evidence_gate: Duplicate, stale, scope-mismatched, transport-uncertain and hypothetical outcomes do not enter n_i, sums or N.
chat_native_reduction.theorem_scope: The deterministic synthetic trace does not establish the stochastic independence/stationarity assumptions and does not inherit UCB1's regret theorem.
